messages:
Samir Rao: Heads up — Bluebloom sent INV-987 for $6,320 and used PO 45210. Our AP lookup shows PO 45210 was superseded by 45210-B when we split billing across two departments in Oct. Invoice due 2024-10-28. attaching: https://s3.redwood/internal/invoices/INV-987.pdf :eyes:
Nina Park: can you paste the invoice header? vendor sometimes writes the wrong suffix (B vs -B) and that trips the matcher
Samir Rao: invoice header:
```
Invoice: INV-987
Vendor PO: 45210
Description: Platform usage + setup
Amount: $6,320
```
Jared Lin: AP flagged this as HLD-PO-MISMATCH and auto-hold kicked in. Without the -B suffix AP won't route to the new approver chain (Dept 33). If vendor can reissue quickly that's ideal to avoid manual exceptions.
Bluebloom Billing: Hi Red team — sorry about the mixup. We will reissue a corrected invoice (INV-987-R1) with PO 45210-B and the contract amendment ref. Uploading now: https://files.bluebloom.co/INV-987-R1.pdf :white_check_mark:
AccountsPayableBot: Invoice INV-987 status updated -> ON_HOLD (HLD-PO-MISMATCH) at 1723460050
Nina Park: thanks. Jared, can AP accept the reissued file and re-run matching, or do we need a manual ticket?
Jared Lin: If the vendor file contains 45210-B we can reattach and re-run auto-matcher. If it still doesn't match, AP will need to raise a manual exception and route to the Dept 33 approver (Marta R.). Expect ~1 hour to clear if everything is attached.
Samir Rao: vendor uploaded link confirmed. I attached to the ticket and added the amendment PDF from procurement.
AccountsPayableBot: Invoice INV-987 updated -> QUEUED_FOR_MATCHING (doc attached) at 1723460178
Jared Lin: matcher re-run complete, invoice matched to PO 45210-B and queued for approval (approver: Marta R.). ETA approval ping ~ 30–90 mins.
Samir Rao: awesome. please flag if anything else needed — vendor asked if we can confirm payment ETA after approval.
Jared Lin: will confirm once Marta approves; projected payment date 2024-11-01. Closing hold after approval.
Bluebloom Billing: Thanks! Confirming we will not re-bill. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
